title: Resuming a completed Codex review delegation fails with a 500 thread/unarchive timeout
outcome: A follow-up to a completed Codex reviewer delegation resumes its thread, or fails with a clear cause, instead of a 500 unarchive timeout that forces a fresh full review.
acceptance: The cause of the 500 unarchive timeout (and the 400 'no archived rollout') for a completed Codex delegation follow-up is identified from source or logs.
A minimal fix lets a follow-up resume a completed Codex reviewer thread, or returns an explicit actionable refusal, with one deterministic test.
